claim.summary: In the proper charged F4 character quotient with max(4,2Delta)<=D<epsilon*n/8, fix H distinct degree<=K character classes and factors a_j of degree<=d_j with nonzero classes and K+sum d_j<=D. Hence any vertex separator has size>=H, although the transfer matrix can have smaller or zero rank. The same applies to H character-selected weighted-domain columns by putting the weight first and charging its degree. This controls natural factored ENS-error networks, not arbitrary representations or exact cancellations among disjoint families.
